alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest plan combines physical environmental processes, ecology, pollution and agricultural systems with applied research. It covers food production and environmental impacts, with specialist food safety and toxicology remaining gaps. The energy plan concentrates on technology, materials and economics. The policy plan concentrates on institutions, public decisions and participation. All three maintain environmental science foundations.
